name: Mirena
title: Glasswright
examine: Salt-coast born, where sand meets fire. Her old master called glasswork a small craft. Her lenses light six towns. She holds everything up to the light first.
lines: Hold it to the light. Everything true has a light it agrees with.
Sand, fire, and patience. Two of those can be bought.
The kilns do not cool. Neither do I, ask anyone.
